  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-028 specifies that the SFMC software must record detected spacecraft faults in a mission fault log. This is a clear, verifiable software requirement consistent with the SRS context describing fault management and logging (see SFMC-REQ-026, SFMC-REQ-027, SFMC-REQ-029). The requirement aligns with fault management best practices described in NASA-HDBK-2203-5.09 §3.2.1.9, which emphasize fault detection, reporting, and logging to support diagnostics and recovery. The requirement is well-scoped, unambiguous, and traceable within the SRS. No software allocation issues or quality deficiencies are identified."
